family_title_en: Read words with digraphs and trigraphs

stages.ix_title: Read words with digraphs and trigraphs

prompt.en: Which word has the same letter team?
prompt.ko: 어떤 단어에 같은 글자 묶음이 있나요?

what_to_do.en: Tap the word with the same letter team.
what_to_do.ko: 같은 글자 묶음이 있는 단어를 누르세요.

stages.choice_rule: Four whole words. Exactly one choice has the same closed-list team as the stem, and the stem word is not repeated. tch is not ch, dge is not ge, kn is not n, and wr is not wh. Tier 1 wrong words have no closed-list team. Tier 2 wrong words have a different real team. Tier 3 wrong words are near misses. Spread the right choice across all four spots. Across the pool use every team: sh, ch, th, wh, ph, ck, ng, kn, wr, tch, and dge.

roots: The stem is exactly one word with exactly one team from sh, ch, th, wh, ph, ck, ng, kn, wr, tch, and dge.
qu, mb, and igh are not teams here, so skip queen, light, night, right, and high.
Use kid words about home, school, food, pets, play, family, or weather. No names, brands, or places.
Skip two-team words such as chick, check, thing, knight, school, knock, wreck, and wreath.
Four whole-word choices, and none copies the stem. Exactly one choice has the stem team.
tch is not the same as ch. dge is not the same as ge. wr is not the same as wh. kn is not the same as n.
Tier 1 wrong words have no closed-list team, such as cat, sun, or map.
Tier 2 wrong words have a different real team. Do not use a clipped look-alike on tier 2.
Tier 3 wrong words look almost right, such as chin beside watch, or page beside fudge.
Blends and vowel pairs are not teams. Do not treat br, st, thr, ee, or ea as the match.
Put the right choice in different positions. Do not leave it first every time.

tier_rules.1: One short easy word such as fish, chip, or duck. The match shares sh, ch, or ck. The other three words have no closed-list team, like cat, sun, or map.
tier_rules.2: A grade 2 word, often two syllables, with th, wh, ph, or ng. Wrong choices have a different team, like wish beside whale or sheep beside thunder. For ng, pair sing with song.
tier_rules.3: Near misses for tch, dge, kn, or wr. A ch word is wrong for a tch stem, a ge word is wrong for a dge stem, a wh word is wrong for a wr stem, and kite is wrong for knit. Exactly one choice matches.
